method: Direct Rust test crate for benchmark-only affinity helper, reusing existing native release serde/rayon/libc/flock-core rlibs. No Cargo or product rebuild. The archived invocation reruns the existing binary with two workers for focused behavior checks; full16-worker baseline/candidate integration validation is separate.
coverage: unset affinity and explicit CPU ordering
partial, malformed, duplicate, and mismatched worker requests
original allowed mask and cpu_set_t capacity bounds
actual per-thread pinning without changing caller mask
actual global and auxiliary pool readback with startup acknowledgment
missing/duplicate verifier thread and invalid singleton-mask rejection
actual /proc named-thread discovery and remote sched_getaffinity readback
limitations: Tests of named verifier discovery use a real test thread named flock-verify; benchmark checks the actual Flock private verifier thread after every completed verification, outside timers. Source audit confirms auxiliary dispatch is serial for these fixed x86_64 Falcon baseline/candidate builds; do not generalize this auxiliary placement to other workloads or architectures.
